== English Theed Palace comparison ==
The 27 January 2003 Rules Supplement directs that the cannons deploy aboard the starfighter. The later wording adds the explicit deploy phase and quantity. The complete 2013 slip also replaces printed Armor 2 with Maneuver 2. The current D-E1 face and printable slip retain that combined wording and statistic.
